about_the_game:
Streamer Jia Xu (“Eggy”) uses a cheat to beat a mysterious player called “I Am God” on stream—and gets hit with an eerie “payback.” That night he dreams a twin-tail girl blasts him… in the groin. Worse, he wakes up and realizes he’s actually turned into a girl.

Now Eggy has to survive in a men’s dorm with:

  • his inseparable best friend Monkey,

  • Monkey’s girlfriend Qin Lian,

  • the campus queen Wu Yangyang (same curse, frosty looks + tough-guy attitude), and

  • Pangpang, a chaotic travel companion who used to be a sweet girl and is now a chubby boy.

As the story unfolds, you’ll face key choices:

  • Join Wu Yangyang to hunt for “I Am God” and seek a way back, or

  • Embrace the present, keep living as a girl, and navigate the complicated feelings that may bloom between you and Monkey.

These are two distinct main routes with different stories and endings—your choices decide the path.

The DEMO includes the complete content of Chapters 1–4. You’ll experience the story of what happens after Dandan suddenly turns into a girl! The tale unfolds in a passionate university guys’ dorm, on campus, and on a girl’s solitary walk home down a dark, quiet street…


Jia Xu (“Eggy”) – A small-time streamer who wakes up as a girl after a cheating incident. Airheaded with a dash of chunibyo; now forced to handle a wild new life in a girl’s body.

Monkey – Eggy’s best friend and roommate. Goofy on the surface, fiercely loyal underneath. Tries to cover for his bro’s “sudden change” and gets pulled into all kinds of ridiculous situations.

Qin Lian – Monkey’s girlfriend, an anime-obsessed girl who takes Eggy in and becomes his first close female friend. With her help, Eggy slowly adapts to a new identity.

Wu Yangyang – The campus beauty with a Shaanxi-accented, tough-guy soul. She shares Eggy’s predicament, and the contrast fuels endless comedy.

Pangpang – A quirky companion met on the road. Once a cute girl, now a chubby boy whose antics make the journey even louder and livelier.

“I Am God” – A mysterious figure who pops up across games and “punishes” cheaters—the mastermind behind the gender-swaps. Who she really is—and why—waits for you to uncover.

  • Fully live-action, fully voiced: Real actors, real performances, real locations. Every beat—joy, anger, grief, and love—lands through on-camera acting for film-like presence.

  • A hybrid presentation: We weave three VN styles—live-action character sprites for dialogue, polished CG stills for key moments, and short live-action clips for climaxes—bringing a fresh look and feel.

  • Two divergent life paths: Your binary choices steer Eggy onto very different routes, each with its own storylines and endings.

  • Laugh-out-loud contrast comedy: Gender misfires spark absurd events and big laughs—while still making room for sincere thoughts on identity and friendship.

  • Auto-save & scene revisit: Auto-saves let you revisit completed scenes to try different options and see alternate endings.

Ready to join Eggy on a bizarre, gender-bending adventure? A live-action visual novel unlike any other is waiting for you!

detailed_description:
Producer’s Note

Hello everyone! I’m “豪豪豪豪HaoHaoHaoHao” from FUNTOO Media—producer, director and game designer of Ballshit. I’m absolutely obsessed with gal-games; I’ve played every title on the “Top 10 Sacred Tools” and “Top 10 Demonic Tools” lists, so I’ve always dreamed of creating my own visual-novel story.

But I come from a film background: I used to work as the video director for a Bilibili content creator whose channel has over 10 million followers. That’s why the entire game is shot in live-action. We agonized over whether to go pure live-action or pure visual-novel… and in the end we smashed the two together. That’s how we got this hybrid: a live-action visual novel.

A lot of you have asked why we picked this theme. Well, I’m a chronic net-surfer—every day I see memes like “Bro, you smell so good” paired with a Palworld emoji, and my brain just starts spinning an entire story from there. Don’t worry, though—the overall tone is light and relaxed, packed with anime-style Easter eggs.

This is our very first game, so there are bound to be rough edges. Please hit the comments with any feedback, and if you can spare the time, give the demo a try. See you at the Steam Next Fest in October!
